theory.title: Next.js Basics
theory.content:
Server Components

Render on server, no JS to client, direct DB access

Client Components

Marked with use client, run on browser, support hooks

App Router

File-based routing in app/ directory. page.tsx = route, layout.tsx = shared layout

theory.title: Rendering Strategies
theory.content:
Static Rendering

Generated at build time (default)

Dynamic Rendering

Rendered on every request

ISR

Incremental Static Regeneration — revalidate cached pages periodically

theory.title: Data Loading
theory.content:
fetch in Server Components

async/await fetch in Server Components. Next.js deduplicates requests

Server Actions

Async functions marked use server, called from client

theory.title: Optimization
theory.content:
next/image

Automatic image optimization, lazy loading, modern formats

next/font

Self-hosted fonts, no layout shift

Code Splitting

Automatic per-route code splitting

theory.title: Deployment
theory.content:
Vercel

Native platform for Next.js, auto-deploy

Self-hosted

npm run build && npm start

Docker

Containerization with output: standalone
